sobre.resumo: I'm Francine, a Software Engineering student and Junior Web Developer. Currently, I work at 8poroito, contributing to the development and maintenance of web applications, implementing improvements, supporting legacy systems, and helping organize version control and deployment processes.
sobre.resumo1: I also have hands-on experience through personal, volunteer, and freelance projects, working with responsive interfaces, APIs, dynamic forms, payment integrations, and agile teams. I seek to continue growing as a developer, combining continuous learning with challenges across both front-end and back-end development.
